text: レッドは　おどろいて　＊円　なくしてしまった……　………　………　………　………　レッドは　めのまえが　まっくらに　なった！
note: The Japanese says everything went pitch black before Red's eyes, a common idiom for being overcome by shock or despair; the English game put "whited out" instead. The Japanese also counts the lost money in yen (円), where the English uses the game's own dollar-like sign.
